The '''Diatian Clockwork''' was an immense [[Ring/Legends|ring]]-like structure which [[Orbit/Legends|encircled]] the [[Planet/Legends|planetless]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Diatia Major]],<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> a part of the [[Diatia Major system/Legends|Diatia Major system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="Southern Core" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Clockwork was constructed out of a metallic alloy and was etched with deep, regular grooves.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

For [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], the Diatian Clockwork attracted visitors who were struck by awe upon witnessing the structure, and it was widely believed to have been constructed by members of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which had disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Over [[Time/Legends|time]], many theories were put forward about the possible purpose of the structure surrounding Diatia Major.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Diatian Clockwork was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the structure was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the Diatian Clockwork was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
